package com.x;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
@NiagaraType
public final class BFoo extends BComponent {
  @NiagaraProperty(
    name = "heatSetpoint",
    // Read-only (never OPERATOR-writable): only the control logic sets it.
    flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY,
    defaultValue = "BDouble.make(0.0)"
  )
  private BDouble heatSetpoint;
  @NiagaraProperty(
    name = "fanSet",
    /* not OPERATOR: computed */ flags = Flags.READONLY,
    defaultValue = "BDouble.make(0)"
  )
  private BDouble fanSet;
  // operator-facing knob
  @NiagaraProperty(
    name = "coolSetpoint",
    // a plain comment
    flags = Flags.OPERATOR,
    defaultValue = "BDouble.make(0.0)"
  )
  private BDouble coolSetpoint;
}
